en.title: Presentify Alternative for Mac
en.heading: Looking for a Presentify Alternative for Mac?
en.description: Looking beyond screen annotation? Explore TeacherPalette’s drawing tools, Spotlight, Magnifier, multi-page Whiteboard and PDF workflow for Mac presentations.
en.summary: Explore a presentation workflow that connects screen annotation, attention tools, Whiteboard and PDFs.
en.lead: TeacherPalette goes beyond screen annotation with tools for drawing, focusing attention, working on a multi-page Whiteboard, and presenting with PDFs.

demo.caption: See screen annotation, attention tools and Whiteboard in the existing TeacherPalette workflow demo. Press play to watch.

ja.title: Presentifyの代替アプリをお探しの方へ
ja.heading: Presentifyの代替アプリをお探しですか？
ja.description: Macの画面に書き込むだけでなく、資料を拡大し、ホワイトボードで図解し、PDFに残したい方へ。TeacherPaletteを授業やプレゼンの流れで試すポイントを紹介します。
ja.summary: Macの画面注釈から拡大鏡、ホワイトボード、PDFまで。授業やプレゼンに合う道具の選び方。
ja.lead: Macで画面に書き込みながら説明したい。さらに、小さな文字を見せたり、図を描いたり、資料に注釈を残したりしたい。TeacherPaletteは、そんな授業やプレゼンの流れを支える選択肢です。

demo.caption: 画面への書き込み、視線を導く道具、ホワイトボードを使う流れを動画で確認できます。再生するとデモが始まります。

ko.title: Presentify 대체 앱: Mac 화면 필기와 발표 도구
ko.heading: Presentify 대체 앱을 찾고 계신가요?
ko.description: 맥 화면 필기에서 돋보기, 여러 페이지의 화이트보드, PDF 주석까지. Presentify 대안을 찾는 분을 위해 수업과 데모에서 TeacherPalette를 비교하고 시험할 기준을 정리했습니다.
ko.summary: 맥 화면 필기부터 돋보기, 화이트보드, PDF까지. 내 수업과 발표에 맞는 도구를 고르는 기준.
ko.lead: Mac 화면에 표시하면서 설명하다 보면 작은 글자를 확대하거나, 질문에 답할 그림을 그리거나, PDF 자료에 필기한 내용을 남길 때가 있습니다. TeacherPalette는 화면 주석에서 시작해 이런 발표 흐름을 이어갈 수 있는 대안입니다.

demo.caption: 화면 필기, 시선 유도 도구, 화이트보드를 이어 쓰는 기존 TeacherPalette 데모입니다. 재생 버튼을 눌러 확인하세요.

en.title: How to Annotate Your Screen on Mac
en.heading: How to Annotate Your Screen on Mac
en.description: Learn a practical Mac screen annotation workflow: choose a drawing tool, make readable marks over apps, clear between steps, and use Whiteboard for longer explanations.
en.summary: A step-by-step guide to marking up the apps you present, keeping annotations readable and returning to your demo.
en.lead: A quick arrow or underline can explain something faster than a paragraph. Here is how to mark up the Mac app you are showing, keep your audience oriented, and return to the task without leaving a screen full of ink.

demo.caption: Watch TeacherPalette’s drawing tools and shortcuts in action. The steps below also explain the workflow in text.

en.title: Screen Annotation for Teachers on Mac
en.heading: Screen Annotation for Teachers on Mac
en.description: Plan clearer Mac lessons with screen annotation: explain slides, websites, code and PDFs, then move to a multi-page Whiteboard when students need a worked example.
en.summary: Practical lesson ideas for slides, websites, software demos, code, diagrams and PDF materials.
en.lead: In a lesson, students need to see both the material and the point you are making. Screen annotation lets you connect those two things while you explain a slide, walk through software, or respond to a question.

demo.caption: The existing Whiteboard demo shows how separate pages can keep a growing explanation organized.
